notes.title: New Player Move, More Findable Items, Steel Rod Reduced Price!
notes.content:
Pleased to announce the following updates are now available :

- Player Move 19 "Psychic Shock & Fire & Poison III" is now purchasable from a travelling merchant.

- The Steel Fishing Rod now cost 5 Mysterious Pearls instead of 9.

- Added more items to find on exterior maps.

- Fixed a sprite formation error typo for the Urban Zombie at level 6.

- Fixed item description errors.

Hope you enjoy, thank you so much for playing!

- Removed clam shell flickering when a fish is present.

notes.title: Added Follow Up Skills for PM17/Bug Fix Near Player's House
notes.content:
- Psychic Shock & Freeze II now has a 50% chance of triggering Critical Freeze or Critical Shock (PM17).

- Removed text that corresponded to a debug room behind a tree near the Player's starting house. No more text loop.

- The Abandoned Farm House will no longer give you one of each crop seed as this was intended for testing purposes.

notes.title: Bug Fixed when Leaving Illegal Dumping Grounds/New Player Skill PM17
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that was conflicting with the Player's move route when leaving the Illegal Dumping Grounds after breaking the wall with the steel hammer for an alternate exit.

- Added a new psychic ability called "Psychic Shock & Freeze II" (PM17) available for 7500 credits at the first travelling merchant right outside the Player's house.

- Added dynamic music to the abandoned farm to lift the atmosphere when planting crops.

notes.title: August 25th - New Achievements and Next Patch Information
notes.content:
I am happy to announce that completing the Atlantis and Egypt maps now have their own Steam Achievements!

Next patch, nine additional Achievements will be available for the Map Generator. Finally, the next patch will also have at least two achievements for owning and running the Gas Station.

I also want to really thank you all for your interest, it has been an honor for anyone to interact with the app so far. ːespressoː ːSkeletalː

notes.title: August 1st Patch
notes.content:
- The Debug Tile behind the Player's house used to test Steam Achievements and Commands has been removed.

- The Tip Giver can no longer block the Player if interacted with South of the counter near the Fishing Guru.

- Gas Station Ghost errors have been fixed.

- The Digital Game Board error where you don't have to pay again to participate has been addressed.

- Applied a patch to address the goldfish error where 2 fish types can unintentionally appear.

- Applied a patch to address the clam fish error where a fish can unintentionally appear.

(Additional patches to the Fishing will be applied very soon this week as conditions have to be met for some fishing glitches to trigger. More testing is needed to thoroughly filter any remaining bugs.)  ːportalː ːfishingː ːespressoː ːtl2engineerː
